analyst_view.overall: Atletico Madrid (23rd, 4 points) and Viking (22nd, 4 points) sit one place apart and both need points to stay in the play-off places, in the clubs' first meeting. Atletico lost 2-0 at home to Bayern last time in Europe but beat Getafe 3-0 on Sunday; Lookman (knee) is out, Marc Pubill (ankle) is back in partial training but still unlikely, and Cuti Romero (muscle) is a doubt, with Le Normand and Hancko expected at centre-back and Hjulmand back from his European ban. The numbers count Lookman and Pubill. Viking, the Norwegian champions, beat Sabah 4-1 and are without Baertelsen, Bjorshol, D'Agostino and Roseth (all counted); new since yesterday, one report (Rotowire, citing NRK) says left-back Kristoffer Haugen is ill and did not travel, with Vetle Auklend set to replace him, and striker Veton Berisha is still a doubt. Belgian referee Erik Lambrechts (2.9 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, 2.6 of them Atletico's, and already take Lookman and Pubill off Atletico (about -2% each) while adding 6% to Viking for Pubill missing at the back. New since yesterday, one report says Viking's experienced left-back Kristoffer Haugen, who started three of their four Champions League games, stayed home ill, which the numbers don't know; that weakens the side facing Giuliano Simeone and Llorente, so I lean slightly higher, about 4.0 (3.9 x 1.03).

corners.text: The numbers expect 11.8 corners, about 8 of them Atletico's, who should have most of the ball at home. Viking's busy recent corner count already adds about 3% to their side and Atletico's quieter run takes 1.5% off theirs; Grimaldo and Giuliano Simeone on the flanks fit that picture, so I stay at about 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 2.9 cards, already cut about 17% for referee Erik Lambrechts, who shows 2.9 a game, and a little for both sides' recent counts. There is no rivalry and Viking are an open, attacking side rather than a cynical one, so nothing points either way and I stay at 2.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.1 shots, 21 of them Atletico's, and already add about 14% to Viking's side for their recent shooting against a leaky Atletico. Atletico at home with Julian Alvarez, Baena and Lee Kang-in, and Sorloth and Jonathan David pushing for minutes, should shoot plenty, which is the usual picture; Haugen's absence matters more for chances conceded than volume, so I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11 shots on target and already take about 2% off Atletico for their accuracy lately. Lookman is counted, the rest of Atletico's front line is fit, and Viking keep finding the target in Europe with top scorer Peter Christiansen fit, so I stay at 11.
